# Crazy Tools

> Free, professional-grade browser-based tools for developers, designers, and everyday workflows. All processing runs locally in the browser unless noted.

Crazy Tools is a large hub of utilities across PDF, image, developer, text, converter, generator, and security categories. Each tool is designed to be fast, precise, and privacy-preserving.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page and universal tool search.
- [All Tools](/tools): Complete catalog of available tools.
- [Sign in](/auth): Optional account for favorites and history.

## Categories

- [PDF](/category/pdf): Compress, merge, and convert PDF documents.
- [Image](/category/image): Compression, OCR, SVG optimization, and conversion.
- [Developer](/category/developer): Formatters, decoders, generators, and developer utilities.
- [Text](/category/text): Case conversion, diff, Markdown export.
- [Converters](/category/converters): Format conversion across images, documents, and data.
- [Generators](/category/generators): QR codes, UUIDs, passwords, and more.
- [Security](/category/security): Hashing, encoding, and token inspection.

## Featured Tools

- [Image to PDF](/tools/image-to-pdf): Combine images into a paginated PDF.
- [PDF Compress](/tools/pdf-compress): Reduce PDF file size locally.
- [PDF Merge](/tools/pdf-merge): Combine multiple PDFs.
- [Image Compressor](/tools/image-compress): Reduce image size with quality control.
- [JSON Formatter](/tools/json-formatter): Format, validate, and minify JSON.
- [QR Code Generator](/tools/qr-generator): Produce high-density QR codes.
- [Base64 Encoder](/tools/base64): Encode and decode Base64.
- [Markdown to PDF](/tools/markdown-to-pdf): Render Markdown to PDF.
- [LaTeX to PDF](/tools/latex-to-pdf): Compile LaTeX to PDF.
- [Image OCR](/tools/ocr): Extract text from images.
- [SVG Optimizer](/tools/svg-optimizer): Minify and optimize SVG files.
